items.title: Apple reveals new AI architecture built around Google Gemini models
items.raw_content: Apple today announced a major overhaul of its Apple Intelligence platform, revealing a new architecture built on foundation models developed in collaboration with Google using the technologies behind the Gemini family. The new architecture centers on Apple Foundation Models co-developed with Google, which Apple says are adapted to run both on-device and on servers through its existing Private Cloud Compute infrastructure.

items.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
items.raw_content:
Authors: NVIDIA, :, Aaron Blakeman, Aaron Thomas, Aastha Jhunjhunwala et al.

We introduce Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Nemotron 3 Ultra is our most capable model yet, employing multiple key technologies - LatentMoE, Multi Token Prediction (MTP), NVFP4 pre-training, multi-environment RLVR, MOPD, and reasoning budget control. Nemotron 3 Ultra achieves up to ~6x higher inference throughput as compared to state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs while attaining on-par accuracy. The state-of-the-art accuracy, high inference throughput, and 1M token context length make Nemotron 3 Ultra ideal for long-running autonomous agentic tasks. We open-source the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, along with the training data and recipe on HuggingFace.
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra：面向 agent 推理的开源高效 MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550-billion-total, 55-billion-active Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention model pre-trained on 20 trillion text tokens and extended to a 1M-token context. NVIDIA reports up to ~6x higher inference throughput than state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs at on-par accuracy, and releases base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints plus training data and recipe on Hugging Face.

items.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra：面向 agent 推理的开源高效 MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550-billion-total, 55-billion-active Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention model pre-trained on 20 trillion text tokens and extended to a 1M-token context. NVIDIA reports up to ~6x higher inference throughput than state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs at on-par accuracy, and releases base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints plus training data and recipe on Hugging Face.

items.title: Mojo: A Promising Tool for Scalable Financial AI Efficiency
items.title_zh: Mojo：提升可扩展金融 AI 效率的潜力工具
items.summary: The article surveys Mojo, Modular's 2026 Python-like systems language, as a structural response to quantitative finance's Python-to-C++ rewrite problem, reporting 20x to 180x speedups over pure Python on directly measured kernels on Apple Silicon, with larger-scale GPU results projected from published benchmarks, and introducing an open-source library of deterministic reduction kernels.

items.title: DUET -- Dual User Embedding Transformers for Offsite Conversion Prediction
items.title_zh: DUET：用于站外转化预测的双用户嵌入 Transformer
items.summary: DUET splits user behavior into separate click and conversion streams and pre-trains dedicated transformer encoders for each, then feeds the combined embeddings to a downstream ranker within serving-latency limits; evaluation reports up to 0.38% normalized entropy reduction and better A/B conversion prediction.

items.title: Stability-Aware Feature Design for Robust Watermark Detection in Machine-Generated Text
items.title_zh: 面向机器生成文本稳健水印检测的稳定性感知特征设计
items.summary: The paper introduces Pattern Stability Score, a watermark-detection framework that combines global and local z-score features with run-length, autocorrelation and paraphrase-stability signals. Across three benchmarks and up to eight rounds of paraphrasing, it improved detection AUC by 10-15 percentage points or more over z-score thresholding and some deep-learning baselines, and a single classifier generalized across LLMs and domains with AUC above 87.8%.

items.title: Minim: Privacy-Aware Minimal View for Agents via Trusted Local Sanitization
items.title_zh: Minim：通过可信本地净化实现 agent 的隐私感知最小视图
items.summary: Minim is a trusted local broker that scores each UI element for inherent sensitivity and task-conditioned necessity, then applies a ternary disclosure policy that keeps essentials, abstracts sensitive attributes or removes irrelevant content before data leaves the device. On WebArena-derived observations it cuts leakage of task-irrelevant sensitive data while preserving the context and interactive affordances agents need to act reliably.

items.title: LLM4RTL: Tool-Assisted LLM for RTL Generation
items.title_zh: LLM4RTL：面向 RTL 生成的工具辅助 LLM
items.summary: LLM4RTL proposes a judge-renew-check-renew-check pipeline that uses a hierarchy of commercial LLMs to filter and refine public Verilog/RTL samples into a higher-quality training set, then adds pre-processing tools that help models infer logical relations from tabular data. It reports gains on VerilogEval and performance comparable to GPT-4O with a much smaller model.

items.title: Trusting Right Predictions for Wrong Reasons: A LIME Based Analysis of Deep Learning Interpretability in Lung Cancer Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 对的预测，错的理由：基于 LIME 的肺癌诊断深度学习可解释性分析
items.summary: A CNN, ResNet50 and ViT trained on the IQ-OTH/NCCD lung cancer CT dataset all reached ROC-AUC of 0.99 and prediction correlations above 0.99, yet LIME explanation correlations stayed below 0.26, showing that agreement in predictions is a poor proxy for agreement in reasoning.

items.title: Towards Global AI-Driven Cervical Cancer Screening
items.title_zh: 迈向全球 AI 驱动的宫颈癌筛查
items.summary: The authors present a deep-learning approach to cervical cancer screening validated on data from multiple countries, combining image-level classification and lesion segmentation in a multi-task model. In in-distribution validation it outperformed medical experts on CIN1- versus CIN2+ classification (balanced accuracy 0.68 vs 0.64), while external validation across four countries showed AUCs ranging from 0.54 to 0.80.
